title: Llegar a ser: The Long Road
goal: Use llegar a ser for the high point of a long road, and tell it apart from hacerse and convertirse en.

items: I can use *llegar a ser* for a result reached after a long road.
I can tell *llegar a ser* from *hacerse* and *convertirse en*.
I can use the new words for careers.
